name: Buzzing Latch Rune
disable: DC 34 Thievery check (master) to disrupt the rune without triggering it or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 31) to magically counteract the rune

items.name: Jolting Buzz
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to open the door without using the key

---
Effect The trap makes a loud buzz and deals 5d10 electricity,5d10 sonic damage to the triggering creature (DC 32 basic Reflex save save; this save applies to both the electricity damage and the sonic damage). Further, the creature must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success No effect.

Success The target is Paralyzed for 1 round.

Failure The target is paralyzed for 1d4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new DC 32 Fortitude save save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Critical Failure The target is paralyzed for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Fortitude save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

text: An invisible rune on the door begins emitting a very loud buzzing sound, potentially paralyzing an intruder.
